title: Diagnose the flaky test
prompt:
Implement `diagnose_flaky(test_record)` — the record has booleans `uses_time`, `uses_random_unseeded`, `shared_state`, `order_dependent`:

- returns `(verdict, causes)`: `'flaky'` when any cause fires, else `'sound'`
- causes are human-readable fixes in fixed order: time → `'reads the wall clock: inject a clock'`; randomness → `'unseeded randomness: seed it'`; shared state → `'shared state: give each test its own world'`; order dependence → `'order-dependent: construct prerequisites in the test'`

Mechanized triage: the reviewer's first five minutes, as a function.

tests.name: every cause reported, in order
tests.code:
rec = {'uses_time': True, 'uses_random_unseeded': True, 'shared_state': True, 'order_dependent': True}
verdict, causes = diagnose_flaky(rec)
assert verdict == 'flaky' and len(causes) == 4
assert causes[0].startswith('reads the wall clock')
assert causes[-1].startswith('order-dependent')
print('ok')
tests.hint: All four suspects checked, in the fixed order.
